conditioning: Query = embed(topic + persona + role anchors). Score = lambda*cos + (1-lambda)*importance + gamma*recency (start lambda ~0.7). Top k=30 packed into 1600-token budget, sentence-truncated. Performer builds context before writing; that retrieval is the sole cross-round cause. Same builder both arms; baseline block empty. Never add a self-reflection stage — it confounds reception gains.
context_budget: role anchors + short buffer (last L=10 utterances in thread, else last L global) + retrieved block
discussion_admission: Each step, agents emit willingness w in [0,1]; admit min(Kmax=5, |w>=0.7|) top by w, deterministic ties. Stop at 150 free-dialogue events or 15 consecutive silent steps.
expected_effect: Craft/Clarity +0.44, Social Response +0.42, 75.6% majority-win — with aggressive-humor drift risk the gates must meter.
note: Mined 2026-10-08 from Multi-Agent Comedy Club (Hong et al.) and RAGthoven (Suppa et al.). Maps: social_memory = long-term shared memory; thread_summary = JokeBlock world-knowledge; critique rows = audience-learning training data. This is CharacterBlockView construction plus relevance-gated wakeup.

pipeline.constraint: Fixed per-joke path: 1 Planner + 1 Writer x12 + 1 Reflector + 1 Judge + audit re-loop on fail only. No open branching or tool search per joke — agentic variants cost far more and judged no better.
pipeline.judge: Internal 1-5 on surprise/resolution/benignness/specificity/punchiness, highest total, tie-break clarity/brevity, prefer valid reflector rewrites. Deterministic constraint audit: no semicolons, headline anchor tokens present, no verbatim copy, word-pair in same clause.
pipeline.planner: CharacterGraph + view + RAG examples in; PITFALLS, STRATEGY, TRICK_TYPE, SCRIPT_A vs SCRIPT_B, VIOLATION, BENIGNING, PIVOT, SETUP/PUNCHLINE_GIST, ANCHOR_TOKENS, 6-8 PREMISES, 6-10 MECHANISMS, SAFETY_NOTE out.
pipeline.reflector: Pre-veto plus repair: DIAGNOSE literal|weak_twist|headline_copy|missing_word_interaction|unsafe_target|semicolon, then 1-2 rewrites preserving tokens.
pipeline.writer: One plan to 12 candidates (best-of-12), 2-3 sentences, no cliche openers, final clause is the pivot, one angle each.

rag_corpus_spec.fields: text, mechanism label, summary, topic, source
rag_corpus_spec.instruction: Mechanisms and angles only — never copy wording or entities.
rag_corpus_spec.retrieval: Embed headline (MiniLM), cosine top-12 over 98, cross-encoder re-rank, inject top-4 as Joke/Summary/Mechanism/Topic/Source.

reception_event.author: agent name
reception_event.parent_id: root thread_id if reply, else null

writeback: After each broadcast round only: keep explicit critique/advice, recurring praise/complaints, concise thread summaries. Assign importance, embed, store with metadata.
